info.name: TransferGuard API
info.description:
Real-time scam and mule-account screening (codename Pengawal). Covers all 19 operations in docs/openapi.yaml.

1. Start the stack: `make up` (optionally `make demo`).
2. Import this collection and `TransferGuard-local.postman_environment.json`, select the environment.
3. Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner, or `newman`). Tokens are fetched automatically from the mock OAuth2 server; requests chain IDs and ETags through collection variables.

Folders use different clients on purpose, so scope checks are exercised: simulator for screening and events, analyst for cases, admin for rules, watchlist and audit.

exec: // Fetches and caches access tokens from the mock OAuth2 server (Cognito-shaped) for three clients:
if (err || res.code !== 200) { console.error(`token for ${clientId} failed`, err || res.text()); return; }

item.name: 0. Health (management port, no auth)
item.description: Actuator on the management port. Readiness includes PostgreSQL but not Redis.

item.name: 1. Authentication and scopes
item.description: Every call needs an access token; each endpoint checks exactly one transferguard/* scope.

item.name: 2. Screening
item.description: Screen a transfer, replay it, misuse the idempotency key, read it back and report its outcome. Uses the simulator client (screening.write, screening.read).

request.description: Small transfer to a new payee: expect ALLOW. Saves screeningId for the next requests.
Same transactionId and body: the stored screening comes back with Idempotent-Replay: true.
Only COMPLETED transfers make the payee known (R2), grow the 30-day profile (R3) and count towards R5.

item.name: 3. Scam patterns (events and rules)
item.description: Feed security and inbound-credit events, then screen the transfers they should catch.

item.name: Security event: device changed 12 minutes ago

request.description: RM 4,800 to a new payee from the new device: R2 and R6 fire (R4 too between 00:00 and 06:00 KL time).
3 senders credited RM 9,000 in the last hour; sending RM 8,100 on reaches the 80% pass-through ratio. Saves caseId.

item.name: 4. Watchlist (R7)
item.description: Reported mule accounts (rules.admin). Every change is audited.

item.name: 5. Cases (analyst)
item.description: Uses the analyst client (cases.read, cases.write). Works on the case opened by the mule HOLD in folder 3.

item.name: Resolve as fraud and watchlist the payee
6. Rules and engine settings (admin)
item.description: Tuning needs If-Match with the ETag from the last read, so two analysts can't overwrite each other.

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set('ruleBody', JSON.stringify({enabled: r.enabled, weight: r.weight, params: r.params}, null, 2));

request.description: Edit the body to tune the rule, e.g. window PT15M. Takes effect in every pod within 60 seconds.
failMode is OPEN, DEGRADED or CLOSED: what screening does while Redis is unavailable.

item.name: 7. Audit (admin)
item.description: Hash-chained audit log: hash = SHA-256(prev_hash || RFC 8785 JSON of the row).
